name: live-intervals-are-anchored-and-commensurable
why: Rubric must-have #7. Ticket 051 round 2 fixed a defect where the two arms' totals measured DIFFERENT quantities under one label: cascade stamps audio_queued per chunk (last chunk wins = time-to-LAST-audio) while Arm A stamps it once from output_audio_buffer.started (time-to-FIRST-audio). Both now anchor on firstAudio = tts_first_byte ?? audio_queued. Live cannot measure endpointing at all — it has no ground truth for when the human stopped — so that row is REMOVED, not blanked. Observed working at HEAD ca40359.

'total detected end of speech → audio starts' — byte-identical, or the two arms' numbers get compared as if they were the same quantity
